adjudication.rationale: In packages/lib/CalendarService.ts, the event write loop filters the available CalDAV/Apple calendars using only the first destination calendar: `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? [];` and then `filter((c) => mainHostDestinationCalendar?.externalId ? c.externalId === mainHostDestinationCalendar.externalId : true)`. With the diff changing `destinationCalendar` to an array and (for collective/team events) appending other hosts’ destination calendars after the organizer’s, a non-main host’s CalDAV credential will often have calendars that do not match the organizer’s externalId. That makes the filter return an empty array, so `Promise.all([])` resolves without error and no event is created, matching the finding’s described silent failure.
